# Roule Rodrigues

> Roule Rodrigues rents scooters and cars on Rodrigues Island (Mauritius),
> direct from local owners, with delivery to your guest house and in-person
> handover. It is also a free island companion: handpicked stays and
> experiences, event tickets, and guides to beaches, viewpoints, hiking and
> local food written by locals. Based in Baie aux Huitres, open every day.
> Booking is direct — no agency, no booking fees. Current daily rates are
> shown on each rental page. Site in English and French (audience largely
> French-speaking: Reunion, Mauritius, France); WhatsApp support in English,
> French and Creole.

## Rent

- [Scooter rental in Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/scooter): models, daily rates, helmet included, online booking
- [Car rental in Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/car): daily rates, guest-house delivery, online booking
- [Location de scooter a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/location-scooter-rodrigues): la page location de scooter, en francais
- [Location de voiture a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/location-voiture-rodrigues): la page location de voiture, en francais
- [Hebergement a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/hebergement-rodrigues): la page hebergement, en francais
- [Taxi and private transport](https://roulerodrig.com/taxi): independent local drivers, price confirmed before you pay
- [Taxi a Rodrigues et transfert aeroport](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/taxi-rodrigues): chauffeurs locaux, transfert depuis Plaine Corail, prix confirme avant paiement, en francais
- [Getting around Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/getting-around): taxis, transfers, scooter and car hire compared
- [Se deplacer a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/se-deplacer-a-rodrigues): taxi, transfert, scooter et voiture compares, en francais

## Stay & Experience

- [Where to stay in Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/stays): guesthouses, lodges and hotels with nightly prices
- [Things to do](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/activities): bookable activities, price per person and session length on each listing
- [Guided tours and boat trips](https://roulerodrig.com/browse/tours): Ile aux Cocos and its bird sanctuary, snorkelling at Riviere Banane, traditional fishing, lagoon trips - with local skippers
- [All experiences in one place](https://roulerodrig.com/experiences): the door for someone who does not yet know which kind they want
- [Que faire a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/que-faire-a-rodrigues): toutes les activites de l'ile, en francais
- [Local food via WhatsApp](https://roulerodrig.com/food): Rodriguan dishes made by locals
- [Manger a Rodrigues](https://roulerodrig.com/fr/manger-a-rodrigues): cuisine rodriguaise a commander, des Rs 80, retrait gratuit ou livraison, en francais
